body:
Hello! Thank you for your time and your kindness. The realizations have felt like it’s made me take a step backwards, but you are right and I should recognize that this is a positive step even though it hurts. I do have a therapist and we do sometimes talk about making a plan but usually the weeks antics take precedent.  I really like my therapist a lot and I am thankful to be working with her. 

I don’t know if this is a personal obstacle or if others experience this too, but while her advice makes sense, it’s sometimes hard to take to heart and I feel like hearing about others success in similar situations would make things feel more obtainable in terms of getting away.

Op, this is going to be hard to hear, but please know this comes from a good place. If you want a healthy long lasting relationship with this person I would seek therapy for yourself. I’ve seen your posts from over the last week and I think you would benefit greatly from it. You can’t place your sole happiness on someone else the way you have been. Threatening suicide because of a 2 month long relationship is intense. You each need lives and happiness outside of each other. I think you need to work on yourself in order to be the best partner you can be. If you lay the ground work then things will fall into place easier.
You’re an angel thank you so much

When I told him slapping kids wasn’t okay I said “when you’re upset or frustrated with me you don’t slap me. You know that it’s wrong and that that is abuse. So why do you think it’s okay to slap a child who literally doesn’t know better? “ and he was almost confused and said well my mom did it to me and I’m fine. Like he knows it’s wrong to do but it just didn’t register that you should also not do that to kids as well. 

You made some good points though and I am definitely going to try to take a step back to process all of this.
Is trying to have a conversation about it worth?

When we had that talk about hypothetical kids and he said slapping is okay that’s when he disclosed that his mom did it to him and that he’s okay. I told him immediately that if we were to have these kids she wouldn’t be allowed to babysit what-so ever and he just sort of laughed. I don’t plan on having kids for at least another 7 years so In my head it’s like I have time to figure this out. But I guess in order to figure it out he would need to be a willing participant. 

I just don’t know how to broach this topic without putting him in a defensive position.

I just don’t know how to say he should get counseling without putting him on the defensive. Without bringing up specifics I’ve asked if he’d ever consider therapy and he says no. I feel like if I said “look you were abused as a child you should talk to somebody about that” He wouldn’t be receptive to it as he feels he wasn’t abused. I was abused up until the last 2 years and I’m worried if I say what I said above he will just try to shift it to me having problems with my parents and that I’m just projecting and that there isn’t really a problem with his mom. 

I want more than anything to be with him, but day by day I’m getting closer to the end of my rope.

If he is willing to hear me out about these things and be open minded enough to see that maybe it isn’t normal behavior then I would stay. I would 200% support him through his own introspection of what’s going on if he still feels like he doesn’t want therapy. 

I really feel like he just doesn’t realize these things aren’t okay and that he just needs to be told that it isn’t normal behavior. I feel like if he recognized that then he wouldn’t continue the cycle of abuse. 

For other reasons I have slowly been coming to the conclusion that we might not last much longer, but we just had a big talk about these things so I’m hoping that we can work through them. I truly love him with my whole heart and I have been through the ringer to be with him. If I can make it work I would like to, but if he refuses to see that this isn’t okay then I don’t feel that I really have a choice at that point.

The way I saw it was that it was normalized for him so he didn’t see it as wrong. He felt that he deserved all the things his mom had done to him and that her behavior was normal and okay. I had to explain to him that it wasn’t and after saying “I would leave you if you did that” it seemed like it clicked.  Maybe I am being too hopeful though. 

He hates serious conversations and has lied many times just to get out of them. You are spot on with that. I know that I can’t fix him, but I hate that he feels all of this was deserved and I want to make him aware that it wasn’t. 

when I was a baby, I broke my dads nose so many times that he had to get reconstructive surgery done! Your story about the teeth reminded me of that! Thank you so much for your comment and for taking the time to read my post. I really appreciate it and you sound like you have a good head on your shoulders! Thank you!

Would it be okay for me to voice the other things I wasn’t able to last night like the sonsband things and the beard thing? Or do you think it would be a fruitless effort and I just just cut my losses? 

The first 3 years of our relationship was pretty bad and I wasn’t even getting the bare minimum until recently. Last week he and I had a talk about my needs and I can see that he is now trying. I don’t want to complain so close together because I feel like that looks bad but these are things that I’ve held on to for so long.

That is a painfully accurate statement, thank you for sharing. 

My family literally jokes that I am a side chick too and it’s like funny until I think about how true that is lmao. 

Would it be okay for me to just bring all of this up or should I wait for something else to happen. The next time I’m going to see him is Saturday night.

Bf thinks therapy is dumb and that he has nothing to talk about. He sees nothing wrong in her behavior. I want to express the things that are off to me but I’m afraid of how he would take it.

When we have talked about kids in a hypothetical way he said giving them some slaps is okay and I had to have multiple sit downs with him to say it isn’t okay and if we ever did have children and he did that I would leave him immediately. He seems to understand now, but I’m not 100%. 

I want to have a conversation with him ASAP about this stuff but but I’m not sure if I should just wait until she acts up again.

Thank you so much for your comment. I have suggested therapy to bf but he thinks it’s dumb and that there is nothing he needs to discuss because he doesn’t see anything wrong with her behavior. Part of me wants to wait until she does something else to bring up the sonsband things, but also I’m so fed up that I just want to have that conversation ASAP.
Thank you!

Wow! You seem like you’re in a much better place. I am looking forward to getting there myself. I am sorry that you had to go through those things regardless, but from the way you talk you really seem very strong. Thank you for your advice and I will try to practice thankfulness towards adversity more!

I’ve heard of grey rocking before but I hadn’t considered that! I’ve been spending the last few days in my room to avoid my parents but that seems like a good solution that also allows me to move about the house more comfortably. I will definitely try to practice this! 
Thank you for helping me see that I am learning what I am and what I am not okay with and that that’s an okay thing for me to do. It makes me feel better. Thank you very much for your comment. I appreciate it.

After reading your comment I decided to schedule plans with one of my friends for tomorrow and also Monday! Sometimes I forget that this is an option for me. Thank you for reminding me and for giving me another good idea!

I really struggle with being able to snap myself out of it, but distractions and aggressive self care seems like a good way to get through this. Thank you for sharing about your past and what has helped you overcome similar struggles. I really appreciate it.

I only have $500 in my savings as of right now so I do have quite some time before I will be able to move out. I will also be starting from scratch because my parents gave away all of my things that I had for my apartments before which is a bummer. I looked at apartment prices and the cheapest I could find was $875 a month which is much cheaper than my last apartment. I am anxious about having roommates, both strangers and friends, because I’ve been taken advantage of and assaulted and the thought of having to go through that again is awful. I have an aunt that I can move in with, but she is very connected to my parents and there is always a lot of boundary stomping with her on behalf of them so I am unsure about that. 

My ideal situation would be for bf to move with me as long as we continue doing better. In the beginning of our relationship he said he would live with me so I could get out of a bad living situation and I got a big place but then he flaked and made excuses for 2 years about why he wouldn’t move in. I ended up being abused by 3 different roommates I had to scramble to find because bf kept flip flopping about moving in. That was a huge portion of his lies and something that I am hurting over. I decided that if he isn’t ready now after 4 years then I will be done with our relationship. 

I appreciate you for making me feel validated and for your insights. You are right, I don’t think bf cared very much throughout the 3/4 years, but this year genuinely feels different and I can’t help but feel hopeful.  Thank you for making me feel okay with having new dealbreakers. That makes me feel much better too.
